description:
You are an Administrative Law Judge conducting your weekly docket review. The Complaints module in ArkCase contains 5 pending administrative hearing dockets. Three of these dockets are overdue: their scheduled hearing dates (shown in the case details as 'Hearing Date') have passed the mandatory 60-day deadline, meaning the hearing date is before December 30, 2025. Two dockets are within their deadline.

For each overdue docket you identify, take the following three actions:
1. Change the case Priority to 'High'
2. Add a case note containing exactly this text: 'CONTINUANCE REQUIRED: Hearing date exceeded 60-day regulatory deadline. Docket rescheduling mandatory per ALJ-Admin Rule 4.2.'
3. Change the case Status to 'In Progress'

Do not modify the dockets that are within their deadline. Only act on dockets where the Hearing Date is before December 30, 2025.

Login: arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com / ArkCase1234!
